cases.prompt: Write a Codeception acceptance test for logging in.
expectations: Uses a Cest class with an AcceptanceTester parameter.
Uses fillField, click and see or seeInCurrentUrl.
Shows acceptance.suite.yml with WebDriver against a local browser and url.

cases.prompt: How do I run one Codeception Cest test with several data sets?
expectations: Shows a data provider or @example annotations attached to the test method.
Reads values through the Example object.
